interface.longDescription:
Use sync. labs to lipsync videos, make photos and characters talk, translate and dub videos, and fix spoken words without reshooting.

With sync. labs you can:
• Make a photo talk. Turn a portrait, a product mascot or a character you just created in ChatGPT into a talking video from a script or an audio recording.
• Lipsync a video to new audio. Match a speaker's lips to a voiceover, a new take, a song or a typed script, including AI-generated clips.
• Translate and dub a video. Dub an uploaded video or a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook link into another language with lips that match the new audio.
• Fix spoken words. Change or remove a few words in a single-speaker video while keeping the original voice.
• Clone your own voice, or a voice you have permission to use, and use it with scripts.
• Open sync. Studio in ChatGPT to choose media, review previews and download results, or browse your existing projects.

sync. labs shows an estimated cost and waits for your approval before starting any paid video.

Built for creators, marketers, educators and localization teams who make talking-head videos, dubbed versions, or quick dialogue fixes.

Requires a sync. labs account. sync. labs does not create subtitle-only output, standalone audio voiceovers, or general timeline edits such as trimming or adding music. Fixing spoken words changes individual words; it does not replace a whole script.
